title: Randomized space
statement: For a space bound $s$, the randomized space class consists of Boolean languages decidable in randomized space at most $c s(n)$ for some natural number $c$, by a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers
There exists a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
The machine satisfies the randomized space-decision condition with bound $n\mapsto c s(n)$
caveat: The referenced RDecidesInSpace predicate is expanded in the supplied material, but the meaning of its auxiliary machine predicates is given only through their names.
